prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years building full‑stack platforms, AI‑agent workflows, and cloud‑native integrations. Delivered production‑grade CRM modules, edge‑hosted AI demos, and automated data pipelines that cut delivery time and operational overhead. Proven ability to prototype solutions from concept to launch while guiding customers and mentoring teams. Strong experience communicating technical value to enterprise users and integrating SaaS applications via APIs.

bullets.text: Built linkme-intops CRM module with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by more than 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high‑value enterprise clients.
Built tycodes.app AI demo generator that turns business URLs into shoppable 3D scroll demos in about one minute using Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2 and D1.
Designed a six‑stage agent pipeline with Interpretable Context Methodology, adding automated verification to prevent hallucinated pricing and claims.
Engineered tycodes.dev on edge infrastructure with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind on Cloudflare Workers, adding a Hono Worker that runs Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audit and pricing models.
Designed zero‑maintenance serverless backends that use Google Sheets via OAuth, removing dedicated server costs.
Secured 50+ qualified meetings per month, exceeding daily quota of two, and set record with 120+ booked meetings in one month.
Mentored and onboarded new representatives, helping them reach conversion rates above 15%.
Led modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud‑native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Built database‑layer automated validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
